label: NEP89
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes: Neuroevolution potential covering 89 elements, from the Zenodo record for arXiv:2504.21286.  CPUNEP, deliberately: the GPU path (GPUNEP against the locally built GPUMD, see GPUMD_BIN) was tried and reverted.  It costs a process spawn plus file IO per single-point call -- ~0.55 s/call over ~39k calls -- and, worse, round-trips forces and positions through text files, which floors the resolvable defect near 1e-9 where CPUNEP reaches 1.19e-16 on the same probe.  The GPU run scored 0.543 with 11 crashes.
